```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(omopesutils)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

cross_tabulations <- params$cross_tabulations
plugin_metadata <- params$plugin_metadata
include_private <- params$include_private
curtail_cross_tabulation <- params$curtail_cross_tabulation
suppress_numbers_below <- params$suppress_numbers_below

plugin_metadata <- purrr::list_transpose(plugin_metadata)

list(
  omop_es_all_tables_headings_html(cross_tabulations, plugin_metadata),
  omop_es_markdown_docs_public_html(plugin_metadata),
  omop_es_field_level_summary_html(cross_tabulations),
  omop_es_cross_tabulations_html(
    cross_tabulations,
    curtail_cross_tabulation = curtail_cross_tabulation,
    suppress_numbers_below = suppress_numbers_below
  ),
  if (include_private) omop_es_data_provenance_html(plugin_metadata),
  if (include_private) omop_es_markdown_docs_private_html(plugin_metadata)
) |>
  purrr::compact() |>
  purrr::list_transpose() |>
  htmltools::tagList() |>
  print()
```
